name: Candlestick chart
purpose: Open-high-low-close (OHLC) per period, one candle per session — a real SVG candlestick chart. Encoding ENACTS ds-027 (Dave, ruled #100, 2026-08-05): solid two-state, table = a11y fallback. Built to the Chart-scatter Layer-1 pattern (toolbar + table spine).

props.name: sessions
props.$note: One candle per session: open/high/low/close. Canon example: 40 sessions, seed 103 (ds-027 standing density rule).

props.name: up
props.$note: close ≥ open — body SOLID fill = data/delta/gain (ds-027, ruled #100).

props.name: down
props.$note: close < open — body SOLID fill = data/delta/loss (ds-027, ruled #100).

props.name: data
props.$note: Real <table class="dv-table"> mirroring OHLC columns per session (dv-005) — THE accessibility fallback per ds-027, not decorative.

props.name: empty
props.$note: No-data state = the Empty-state pattern by reference.

variants.name: forty sessions
variants.use: Realistic-density price series (ds-027 standing rule) — wick per session (ink @ reduced weight), body SOLID both directions, coloured by close-vs-open only.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class — axis ticks/labels .t-cm-chart-label/-value · table .t-cm-legal

delta.$note: ds-027 RULED binding (#100), consumed VERBATIM from canon.css (--data-delta-gain #16864E/#1AA05C, --data-delta-loss #B92F1E/#CC4333 light/dark), not re-derived. Owned by the RAG/delta colour workstream.

tokens.axis: ⛔ ds-020 RECEIPTED GAP — pre-DV-D07 ink-at-alpha idiom, not the minted two-channel roles. Copied the mark contract + toolbar per the DIVVY brief, deliberately NOT the axis/grid CSS. Unchanged by the ds-027 enactment.
tokens.$survey: Grounds its vocabulary in Chart-bar (toolbar, frame, grid convention pre-DV-D07) and the data/delta/* tokens minted for the RAG/delta workstream. ds-027 (#100) enactment retired the #96-D1 ① hollow-up channel this component originally shipped with.

motion.entry: Each candle fades in on a stagger — CSS-only (DEF-003).
motion.reducedMotion: Fade sits inside prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference; global collapse also present.

responsive.rule: DV-D02: compress width, never scale — text must not scale. Static (JS-off) answer: fixed 580×260 + horizontal scroll. FIT WIRED (ds-027 standing rule, #100: 'all these charts should be fully responsive, so the 580 sizing doesn't really apply') — every candle <g> carries data-fx/data-x0, axis gridlines/baseline carry data-fx/data-fx2, labels carry data-fx/data-dx; dv-behaviour.js's fitOne() translates candle groups and repositions axis elements on resize.

mustNotNeighbour: A second chart re-using data/delta/gain·loss for a DIFFERENT semantic (e.g. status ramp) in the same journey (dv-014)

accessibility.role: figure role="group" + aria-labelledby → sr-only figcaption; svg role="img" with a data-summary aria-label describing the series' range, open and close.
accessibility.name: Figcaption names the chart; each candle body carries data-tip/aria-label with full OHLC; the real table is the full data surface.
accessibility.keyboard: Candle bodies are tabindex 0 with aria-label; value popover behaviour wired (dv-behaviour.js, AUTO-BEHAVIOUR block present and active).
accessibility.nonText: Gain/loss fills ≥3:1 vs the page both modes (dv-016 — DECLARED, not yet render-verified, see receipt). ds-027 (Dave, #100): SOLID two-state — colour = close vs open only, fill in BOTH directions. The #96-D1 ① hollow-up non-colour shape channel is RETIRED; the real OHLC data table is now the accessibility fallback for colour-blind/greyscale reading (Dave: 'we're using the table as the fallback position for Ally').

antiPatterns: Raw hex fills for gain/loss (dv-017 — must ride data/delta/gain·loss)
Re-deriving gain/loss instead of consuming the canon.css tokens (creates a second source of truth)
Scaling the SVG proportionally at narrow widths (DV-D02 — text must never scale)
A chart without its real data table (dv-005)

tokenValidation.result: DECLARED, mechanical var()-only fill audit clean (_validate_snippets.py) — see #101 enactment receipt for render-verify numbers.
tokenValidation.$note: ds-027 (#100) ENACTED #101: solid two-state rewrite, 40-session seed-103 dataset, dv-fit wiring, manifest + header comments recite ds-027.

mustNotNeighbour.$note: A second chart re-using data/delta/gain·loss for a DIFFERENT semantic (e.g. status ramp) in the same journey (dv-014)
